source.check: returned unopposed after a withdrawal: 'Mr. Matthew Mitchell, J.P. ... was to have been challenged in the Foreglen division ... Yesterday Mr. Mitchell's opponent Michael O'Neill (N.), Ballymacianigan, withdrew' (Londonderry Sentinel 19 May 1949 p6, image OCR read; Derry Journal 20 May 1949).

note: Triennial election of the 23 electoral divisions of Limavady rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. Six contests were nominated, but withdrawals reduced these to four. The Unionists regained control, taking Drumraighland on a drawn lot after a tie. Sixteen of the nineteen unopposed members added from the nominations reports (Londonderry Sentinel, 19 May 1949, p. 6; Derry Journal, 20 May 1949), which name them without divisions: Foreglen and Scriggan from the withdrawals the reports describe, the other fourteen from their divisions at the 1946 return. Aghanloo, Feeny and The Highlands are held: their members (W. J. Thompson, James O'Kane and John Alcorn) are not in the 1946 return, and only later sources place them (round-2 gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
